course.title: Youth Impact Training Programme (YITP)
course.description: YITP is organized into six units designed to transform participants’ mindset, skills, and career prospects. Unit 1, Understanding Purpose in Life (UPL), focuses on discovering strengths, clarifying values, setting goals, and drafting a personal mission statement through self-discovery exercises and workshops.
learning_objectives: Practice structured self-discovery and values clarification
Set goals aligned to purpose and career direction
Draft a personal mission/ purpose statement

modules.title: Understanding Purpose in Life (UPL 101)
modules.description: An 8-lesson, 2-week part-time module guiding learners to define, live, and share a life purpose through African stories, classic personal-growth frameworks, reflective journaling, and peer activities.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Life’s Purpose
lessons.content:
Objective

Understand what purpose means and why it matters.

Key Ideas

  • The Story of the Three Builders (cathedral vision).
  • 7 Questions for Clarity.
  • Purpose → Vision → Goals; exemplars: Gandhi, Mandela, Mother Teresa.

Activity

Reflective journaling: “When did I feel most alive and fulfilled?”
lessons.learning_objectives: Define life purpose; distinguish purpose, vision, and goals; identify personal clarity signals.

quiz.title: Lesson 1 Checkpoint
quiz.description: Short check on core ideas from Lesson 1.

questions.question_text: In the Three Builders story, the third bricklayer describes himself as a…
questions.explanation: He connects his task to a larger, meaningful vision.

questions.question_text: How we interpret actions depends on the purpose behind them.
questions.explanation: Mindset and purpose shape our interpretation of work.
Purpose begets vision; vision begets goals.

questions.question_text: The 7 Questions are intended to help discover one’s purpose.
questions.explanation: They are a guided self-discovery prompt set.

questions.question_text: Which leader is correctly paired with the theme highlighted in this lesson?
questions.explanation: Mandela’s purpose centered on liberation and justice.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Foundations of Purpose
lessons.content:
Objective

Explore foundational principles for finding purpose.

Key Ideas

  • Baobab “Tree of Life” — service and sustenance.
  • Napoleon Hill: Definiteness of Purpose — get clear, fuel desire, act daily.
  • Zig Ziglar’s Wheel of Life — balanced growth across domains.

Activity

Rate your Wheel of Life and identify one improvement in each spoke.
lessons.learning_objectives: Explain ‘definiteness of purpose’; connect purpose to service; apply the Wheel of Life.

questions.question_text: The baobab is called the “tree of life” because it sustains communities with food and water storage.
questions.explanation: It stores water and produces nutrient-dense fruit.

questions.question_text: A key takeaway from the baobab story is:
options: Purpose is only personal, not about service
Minor purposes must replace the major purpose
questions.explanation: Service is central to sustainable purpose.

questions.question_text: The Wheel of Life suggests balancing multiple domains to avoid a ‘wobbly ride’.
Which daily habit aligns with Og Mandino’s approach?
options: Delay action until conditions are perfect
questions.explanation: Gratitude is a core Mandino habit.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Purpose and Service
lessons.content:
Objective

Connect personal purpose to service.

Key Ideas

  • “Send the Elevator Back Down” proverb — mentorship and opportunity.
  • Lessons from Mother Teresa and Nelson Mandela.
  • Humility and selflessness as foundations of service.

Activity

Reflection: Who are you serving today and how?
lessons.learning_objectives: Describe how service multiplies impact; identify practical acts of daily service.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Overcoming Obstacles to Purpose
lessons.content:
Objective

Push through internal and external challenges.

Key Ideas

  • Folktale: Tortoise and the Heavy Load.
  • Fear vs. faith; courage in adversity.
  • Building inner clarity.

Activity

Visualization: picture breaking through a major barrier.
lessons.learning_objectives: Recognize typical blockers; apply visualization for resilience.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Tools to Define Your Purpose
lessons.content:
Objective

Craft a personal purpose statement.

Key Ideas

  • Anecdote: Fisherman & Merchant.
  • Success Afrika techniques; passions & strengths; values alignment.

Activity

Draft your purpose statement and get peer feedback.
lessons.learning_objectives: Synthesize passions, strengths, and values into a clear statement.

lessons.title: Lesson 6: Purpose in Action
lessons.content:
Objective

Integrate purpose into daily living.

Key Ideas

  • Proverb: “The child who is not embraced by the village…”
  • Purposeful habits; time management; African exemplars.

Activity

Create a weekly schedule aligned with your purpose.
lessons.learning_objectives: Plan habitual, time-bound actions aligned to purpose.

lessons.title: Lesson 7: Sharing & Sustaining Your Purpose
lessons.content:
Objective

Inspire others and sustain momentum.

Key Ideas

  • Clay Lamp story; Zig Ziglar’s ‘help others get what they want’.
  • Ongoing growth via Success Afrika and other resources.

Activity

Design a small community project that reflects your purpose.
lessons.learning_objectives: Translate purpose into community impact and mentorship.

lessons.title: Lesson 8: Reflection & Forward Planning
lessons.content:
Objective

Consolidate learning and set a clear path forward.

Key Ideas

  • Allegory: River & Stone — persistence shapes outcomes.
  • Review purpose statements; resilience strategies; inspiring by example.

Activity

Present purpose statements and one-year action plans.
lessons.learning_objectives: Finalize a purpose statement and a 12-month action plan.
